correctness.rationale: Derivations correspond exactly to f d/dt subject to N t^(N-1)f=0. For char ≠2, 2f²=0 forces valuation contradiction with ff′=f. For char2, D² is derivation; ff′=f implies f′=1 whenever f≠0, giving every coefficient normal form. Distinct monomial leading degrees prove rank floor(N/2). The coordinate substitution s=f−f(0), and rescaling for nonzero constant, establishes all automorphism orbits. Standalone exhaustive original-equation checks passed 16 finite field/truncation cases; the infinite theorem rests on this symbolic proof.
